emails.subject: Night shift briefing: Thu 11/19
emails.body:
Casey,

You came back. Good. Not everyone does, the second night.

Retention sent over your numbers from last night. They say you're coming along nicely. I didn't know they kept numbers on night staff.

Tonight's work is in your Work Queue. Same order as always:

1. ARCHIVE: Batch 45, then Batch 46.
2. WORK ORDERS: Personnel first. Approve ONLY if the owner is TERMINATED.
3. JUNK: the temp file goes in the bin.

If the other pointer moves your files, let it. If it puts anything in your queue, you don't have to do it. We didn't send it.

Custodial rounds start at 3:00. Stay seated.

Ruth Hale
Night Operations Supervisor

emails.subject: you ok?
emails.body:
Casey,

I came by last night around two to drop off Gary's box for you (the duck mug, a paperback, his reading glasses). Your car wasn't in the lot. Security says nobody badged into B-Level after midnight.

But your screen was on. I could see it from the stairwell window. Somebody was moving the mouse.

Are you taking the bus? Call me. I'm up late.

Denise

emails.subject: B-7 door sensor
emails.body:
Casey,

The B-7 door sensor recorded no activity from your badge last night. No open, no close. Our log shows B-7 unoccupied.

The only entry is Custodial, 3:00 AM.

If you worked in B-7 last night, please badge in at the B-Level door tonight so the log is correct. The sensor was tested this morning. It works.

Harold Whitcomb
Facilities

emails.subject: Re: remote activity
emails.body:
Casey,

Retention says there's remote activity on WS-04 again. Items in your queue that didn't come from us.

Don't do them. Whatever it asks you for, it's asking for itself.

If anyone asks, tell them I checked in.

Ruth

emails.subject: URGENT: employee_209.dat (reclaim before 3:00)
emails.body:
PRIORITY ORDER: OFFICE OF RETENTION

A held record, employee_209.dat, has surfaced on the WS-04 desktop.

The record is incomplete. You are instructed to SHRED it before Custodial rounds begin (3:00 AM). Reclamation will complete it.

- Do not open it.
- Do not archive it.
- If it asks you to finish it, do so.
- If the other record asks you to stop, do not reply.

This order supersedes all other work.

A. Voss
Director of Retention

emails.subject: Camera Viewer during rounds (effective tonight)
emails.body:
Effective tonight, B-Level operators have Camera Viewer access during Custodial rounds.

When rounds begin, Security opens the viewer. Keep it open until rounds are complete. Do not close or minimize the viewer.

This is for your safety.

Leonard Brandt
Security Supervisor
